name: Alex (male form)
source:
Nameable protagonist (default name: Alex). He ends up experiencing strange transformations, after the most recent Emily's invention didn't work as expected.

Note: For the purpose of convenience, this entry applies to all cases where Alex is still biologically male, even if other physical changes occur.
